PplnInspListViewCalcClmn.name: PplnInspListViewCalcClmn
PplnInspListViewCalcClmn.description: Represents a column configuration for a pipeline inspection list view. Determines which calculated columns appear in a pipeline or intelligence view and their display order.

ColumnName.description: The type of calculated column to display in the pipeline or intelligence view.

ColumnWidth.description: The width of the column in pixels. If null, the default column width is used.

PipelineInspectionListViewId.description: The ID of the pipeline inspection list view that this calculated column belongs to.

SortOrder.description: The position of the calculated column in the list view. Determines the display order of columns from left to right.
